coverage.finding: Reviewed 2026-10-01: The own one-page 3DXSTAT ESD-TPC90A TDS gives values and printed-specimen preparation, but no named intended use or post-print finishing basis. ESD/TPC naming and specimen preparation alone do not establish an application. The filename92A does not override its own90A title. Reviewed source basis: X-ECOMAX-ESD-TPC-92A-v3. This is a gap in the reviewed originals, not public-source exhaustion or universal absence; a concrete new official-source lead can reopen the question.

polymer.basis: Classification and typical values from polymer handbooks and resin data sheets, as compiled for the estimate model (docs/audits/2026-09-15-filtering-estimates-data/physics/). The document cited prints a density inside the range, not its ends. DuPont's Hytrel design guide, module V (R-DUPONT-HYTREL-MODULE-V), prints specific gravities of 1.11 to 1.22 for eight grades, G3548W to 4069 (ASTM D792, ISO 1183), and a water absorption of 0.6 to 5 % after 24 h (ASTM D570, ISO 62), table 2, p. 9.

Hytrel 20UV concentrate or other protection from UV light should be incorporated in all products of Hytrel that are used outdoors or exposed to direct sunlight via windows or reflective surfaces. In very thin parts, especially those less than 0.55 mm (0.02 in) thick, degradation due to UV radiation can be caused by exposure to incandescent or fluorescent lighting.
